Market today: The Middle East oil situation is the main driver, pushing up energy prices. This is a headwind for tech/chip names, which is most of your book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.15%) and SPAL (-30.8%) are flagged for attention. They are leveraged ETFs and are deep in the red, amplified by margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on oil prices and any spillover into broader market sentiment.

Bottom line: Manage your risk on the leveraged names and watch for any signs of tech weakness.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or stopping out given the deep loss and leveraged nature.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate stopping out to preserve capital.
NVDA: Scanner shows ACCUMULATE at 218.07-217.85, stop 217.43. Watch for confirmation.
